prose: Axios reports Reddit plans to require users to log in to fully access the site, a direct response to AI scraping, and will test the change in select markets outside the US this quarter. Reddit called it a move to become a primarily logged-in experience - one of the most significant shifts in its 21-year history.
highlights: Reddit to require login for full site access, citing AI scraping
Testing in select non-US markets this quarter
Framed as becoming a primarily logged-in experience after 21 years
basis: The fetch failed with HTTP 403 (Axios bot-block), so this entry is based on the Techmeme feed summary and headline.
